author: MyLightsWentOut
body:
Hello Avicus,

I was banned for excessive rudeness because I was being stupid. I regret my decision on being rude to other users. I promise I won't be rude to anyone and I also will make a promise that I have changed and am no longer rude. Please unban avicus because I really want to give this another shot.
